$comment: Cleanup coverage is derived: each literal resource "gcore_*" block in a package's
test files must have a registered sweeper (resource.AddTestSweepers). This file holds
only what that scan cannot see:
fixtures            - types a package creates outside its HCL, e.g. through the SDK
(the guards fail if an SDK create call has no entry here);
reclaimed_by_parent - child type -> parent type deleted together with it;
sweeper_names       - type -> sweeper registered under a different name.
